instruction: I keep a log of all my liked songs and respective artists in a note in simple_note. I want to add release month information for them as well. I have added it for the first few songs. Add it for the rest.
notes: Single-note update task: find the liked-songs log note (search_notes + show_note), look up release dates of the supervisor's liked songs on Spotify (show_liked_songs, paginate at runtime until all liked songs are covered; call spotify.show_song per song if release_date is absent from the list), then rewrite only the note content so every line reads '- <title> BY <artist1,artist2> RELEASED_AT <month>' following the format of the first few already-annotated lines. Knowledge is modeled at the collection level (note-content-known, release-months-known) since the individual songs are only discovered at runtime. Only the content field of the one note may change; no notes are created or deleted; complete_task takes no answer (its PDDL parameters are the task record only).
